english.title: Unavailable for jury service / unfit to serve on a jury when summoned due to drink / drugs
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), after attending **(..SPECIFY VENUE..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE OF ATTENDANCE..) in pursuance of a summons under the Juries Act 1974 were

(A)_[not available when called on to serve as a juror]_
(B)_[unfit for service by reason of drink or drugs]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 20(1)(b) of the Juries Act 1974.
